subject: Stage gating & commit triage — Q3 scrub and exec readout prep
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: finance_ops@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Stage gating & commit triage — Q3 scrub and exec readout prep

Team —

We need to run a tight monthly scrub this week to firm Q3 commit numbers for the leadership pack. Please treat this as the single source of truth for anything you expect to include in the exec readout. Key asks: 

- Update SFDC stage to one of: Commit / Commit-likely / No-go by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-05).
- For any deal marked Commit or Commit-likely, add a one-line rationale and the confirmed committed ACV in the "stage-triage-log.csv" (attached).
- Flag deals with >30% risk and add the short remediation plan.
- Upload a one-pager for any deal >$250k to the Drive folder below.

I've attached an exec_readout_template.xlsx and a blank stage-triage-log.csv (also copied to the Drive). Meeting timelines:
- Managers triage: Aug 7, 10:00–11:00 PT (working session)
- Leadership readout slot: Aug 10, 09:00–09:30 PT (final numbers)

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XqQ-ExecReadout_Q3

Please include me and your revenue ops contact on any redline/procurement issues you want me to escalate. If you're blocked by procurement timelines (large logos), flag it explicitly in the comments column.

Attachments: exec_readout_template.xlsx (template), stage-triage-log.csv (blank)

Thanks — aim for concise entries so we can assemble the pack quickly.

— Mina Haddad
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance_ops@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage gating & commit triage — Q3 scrub and exec readout prep

Thanks Mina — on it. Quick Q: does the triage include renewals and upsells, or are we focusing on net-new only? I have a couple of renewals that look like commits but SA needs to confirm terms.

I'm attaching my working export (Rishi_commit_updates.csv) — I'll mark Deal-2381 (Nimbus) as Commit pending PO receipt (expected Wed). If PO doesn't arrive, I'll move it to Commit-likely and note the procurement blocker.

- Rishi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Rishi_commit_updates.csv (attachment)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage gating & commit triage — Q3 scrub and exec readout prep

Mina — looping in a note on Acme Corp. Procurement just signaled a month-long legal review; commercial expects to close but we do not have a PO timeline. I suggest we mark Acme as Commit-likely not Commit until the PO is in hand. I can reach out to Emily Park to push but will need either a signature authority or a payment term agreement to accelerate.

Also: for deals where procurement is the blocker, can we add a separate column in the CSV for "procurement_owner" and "expected_PO_date"? That will make the exec pack clearer.

I will upload a short note for the Acme opportunity into the Drive (file name: acme_procurement_note.md).

— Laura
GM, Strategic Accounts

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage gating & commit triage — Q3 scrub and exec readout prep

Thanks Mina — will upload my one-pagers for all >$250k deals by EOD Tuesday. Quick ask: are the one-pagers expected in the exec_readout_template.xlsx format or is a PDF one-pager acceptable? I attached the ones I have so far (marcus_commit_onepagers.pdf).

Also: strongly recommend we add a "Top 3 risk items" slide to the exec readout — that will help the leadership discussion focus on mitigations, not just numbers.

— Marcus
Head of Enterprise Sales
marcus_commit_onepagers.pdf (attachment)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: finance_ops@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage gating & commit triage — Q3 scrub and exec readout prep

Appreciate the quick responses. Final notes: 

- Renewals: include renewals and upsells in the triage if the revenue contributes to Q3 targets. Mark them clearly in the comments column.
- Laura: agreed on procurement columns — I've added "procurement_owner" and "expected_PO_date" to the CSV (final_commit_export.csv attached).
- Marcus: PDFs are fine; please ensure the first page follows the template header so we can drop into the deck automatically.
- Rishi: thanks — if Nimbus PO doesn't land by EOD Wed, mark Commit-likely and note the escalation point.

I created the calendar invites for the managers working session (Aug 7 10:00 PT) and the leadership readout (Aug 10 09:00 PT). Please RSVP and upload your final CSV rows + one-pagers to the Drive before the manager meeting so we can lock numbers.

If anyone wants me to reach out to a procurement contact directly, send me the name and email and I will escalate. For Acme I can do an intro to Emily Park; Laura, if you confirm you'd like me to include Emily, I'll add her to the thread.

Attachments: final_commit_export.csv

Thanks — Mina
Director, Revenue Operations
